input.summary: Add a direct third-party IP infringement limb to RevMed's indemnity in Section 14.1, with customary modification/combination exclusions, and conform the carve-out cross-reference.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.1 only reaches third-party IP claims indirectly, through breach of RevMed's (largely knowledge-qualified) IP representations, while Section 14.2(a) leaves us carrying infringement exposure from our Development and Commercialization of the licensed compound. We have added a direct infringement/misappropriation limb for the RevMed Licensed Technology, subject to the customary modification and combination exclusions, consistent with our position that the licensor defends IP claims on the technology it provides.

ops.text: (d) any Third Party Claim alleging that the RevMed Licensed Technology, or the Research, Development, Manufacture or Commercialization of SHP2 Inhibitors or Products in accordance with this Agreement, infringes or misappropriates any Patent Right or other intellectual property right of a Third Party, except to the extent such Third Party Claim arises or results from (i) any modification of the RevMed Licensed Technology made by or on behalf of Sanofi other than as contemplated by this Agreement or (ii) the combination of the RevMed Licensed Technology with any compound, product or technology not provided or specified by RevMed;
